description: This PHP source file handles the retrieval and display of email image attachments associated with notes in the SuiteCRM system. It validates the request, retrieves the note object, verifies the image, and outputs the image with the correct MIME type.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: The Note class represents notes attached to emails in the CRM system, but the class definition is included via an external file and not shown here.

methods.name: retrieve_by_string_fields
methods.description: Retrieves a note record based on specific string fields, used here to verify the note is an email attachment.
